issue_request: FHIR-37664 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Clinical Genomics change request to add MolecularSequence.relative.ordinalPosition (integer) and MolecularSequence.relative.sequenceRange (Range) so multiple relative reference-sequence segments could be composed with explicit ordering and composed-sequence coordinates.
initial_application: Commit e1892fd7be59be5495827c6f662cd9edeba6fc19 added both requested elements to source/molecularsequence/structuredefinition-MolecularSequence.xml. The checked R5 release-history artifact still contains MolecularSequence.relative.ordinalPosition and MolecularSequence.relative.sequenceRange with the requested definitions and types.
additional_context: Clinical Genomics minutes for 2022-07-12 record FHIR-37664 in block vote T with a 13-0-0 passage and discussion of ordinalPosition versus intrinsic list order. The linked Zulip thread shows the proposal, review of Range for sequenceRange, and confirmation that the changes reached the FHIR Core build. Later source history removed source/molecularsequence, and current diagnostics text says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition. Current fhir.ini comments out molecularsequence in the workgroup/resource-adjacent entries while moleculardefinition is active.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested R5 MolecularSequence elements are already present in R5 history, and the current build has no active MolecularSequence StructureDefinition. Adding analogous fields to MolecularDefinition would require a new Clinical Genomics modeling decision rather than bounded application of FHIR-37664.
